title: Second Brain
tagline: Notes on the Bhagavad Gita, the Mahabharata, and whatever else I'm studying.
author: Shubh Karman Singh
intro: These are my study notes — mostly on the Bhagavad Gita and the Mahabharata, written as I work through them chapter by chapter. They are notes, not teaching: paraphrases in my own words, my own questions, and the places I'm still stuck. I keep them public so I'm forced to write them clearly.
